assets.name: Bola de liaison
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single isolated raster effect for a detailed hand-painted 2D fighting game set in Death Stranding 1, to replace the game's existing Canvas effect. This is a gameplay visual adaptation, not a new official weapon. ONE effect per image, entire effect visible and centered with generous 15% transparent padding on all sides, sharp small-scale readability. High detail tactile materials, restrained cinematic lighting. Subject: ONE flying strand binding bola, a thin braided tan-gold binding cable stretched into an open horizontal loop, two compact weighted dark metallic ends, each about one eighth the loop width. A sense of rightward travel, cable loop trails gently left. Practical utilitarian material appropriate to Sam's nonlethal strand equipment, no gun, no hands, no other object. The loop stays mostly horizontal, width roughly three times its height. No oversized sci-fi sphere, flames, lightning, text or logo. Genuine alpha outside the cable and weights, including the hole inside the loop; no background, no floor, no shadow, no checkerboard.
assets.official: Bola Gun canonique; silhouette et animation de projectile adaptées pour la lisibilité 2D.
